title: JupyterHub Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and operating the multi-user JupyterHub notebook server.

JUPYTERHUB_SERVICE_USER.description: System user account running the JupyterHub daemon (created if nonexistent).

JUPYTERHUB_SERVICE_GROUP.description: Primary system group assigned to the JupyterHub daemon user.

JUPYTERHUB_IP.description: Bind IP address on which JupyterHub listens for incoming HTTP connections.

JUPYTERHUB_PORT.description: TCP port on which JupyterHub listens for incoming HTTP connections.

JUPYTERHUB_NOTEBOOK_DIR.description: Default working directory for spawned user notebook servers (created if nonexistent).

JUPYTERHUB_VENV.description: Filesystem path to the isolated Python virtual environment hosting JupyterHub.

JUPYTERHUB_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrative password or salted Argon2 password hash for JupyterHub.

GROUP.description: Fallback system group name used when creating the JupyterHub service account.

PYTHON_VERSION.description: Python interpreter version provisioned for the JupyterHub virtual environment.
